name: casafari-comparables
description: Casafari Comparables: estimated prices, comparable properties and, in Spain, registry sale prices around any property in 14 European countries.

interface.longDescription: Value any property from an address, a point on the map or, in Spain, a cadastral reference. Comparables returns an estimated sale price or rent with its range, the comparable properties behind it (size, price, price per m², distance) and, in Spain, prices from official registry records. Works for homes and for commercial property: shops, offices, warehouses, restaurant premises. Coverage: Andorra, Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Luxembourg, Monaco, Poland, Portugal, San Marino, Spain and Switzerland. Built by Casafari, the AI agent-native real estate data intelligence platform; each property counts once in its deduplicated property graph.
defaultPrompt: What is a 90 m² flat at Calle de Alcalá 120, Madrid worth?
